descriptions.w3d_d24g_camera_system_start_8006f62c: Camera system start: queries 0x8015a6b8, reads Camera.Entity.TaskId into +76 and Camera.Data, applies the data, then either computes the three vectors at +4..+28 and starts the camera task with them, or copies them from the source object, and posts eight camera-mode messages (Fire, Flying, WormAiming, WormFirstPersonAiming, WormMoving, WormRoping, UtilityGirder, CameraSelect).
